surfaces.note: Every user-facing language feature must be classified individually before rc.1.
Public modules and APIs must be classified before rc.1.
ABI version and promised layouts/calling conventions must be defined before rc.1.
Stable 1.x core: help, version, C compile/run, test and fmt; flow run propagates the executed program's exit status.
Specialised backends, graphics/audio/debug tooling, advanced compiler commands and package/native workflows remain outside the Stable CLI promise unless separately promoted.
Stable project core: package name/version/entry, string path aliases, upward manifest discovery and forward-compatible unknown extensions.
Dependency acquisition/source forms, dev dependencies, native linking, publication metadata and development-policy tables remain Experimental pending package/security qualification.
Target stability follows the Tier-1/Tier-2 platform decision.
Not part of the default 1.0 production target unless separately qualified.
Not a Tier-1 1.0 target unless separately qualified.
The ahead-of-implementation proof corpus does not define Stable Flow 1.0 syntax.
Abort, retry and multi-shot continuation capture are outside the shipped tail-resumptive 1.0 model unless implemented before freeze.
